summary: First public multi-llm-review predecessor: OAuth peer reviews through Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity, governor self-exclusion, reproduction-gated findings and recorded suggestion dispositions.
Added install/login guidance, candidate-CLI detection, report schema/version fields, a Node 18 guard, troubleshooting tables and README flowcharts.
Published five reviewer routes including Grok, personas, input-scaled timeouts, run labels, opt-in stored input, minimum-success gates and stale-input detection.
Published the public evidence site and introduced private per-workspace dashboards rebuilt and opened with ledger.mjs --open.
Completed reviews rebuild the private dashboard and expose evidence.ledger_url plus a stderr link; added POSIX, Windows-drive and UNC file-URL tests.
Moved Copilot and Antigravity contracts into prompt files; corrected redaction offsets, merged-severity downgrades and Grok doctor command resolution.
Added owner-only POSIX evidence permissions and surfaced private ledger links through structured events, the live interface and stderr.
Added cached daily version notices, NO_UPDATE_CHECK opt-out, version-format validation and a cache-path symlink guard.
Introduced a loopback Setup Center with controller selection, provider maintenance, version diagnostics, explicit interactive actions and terminal onboarding.
Hardened Host validation, stale verification, terminal-launch errors, newline-command refusal and Windows timeout budgeting.
Corrected provider authority and commands; added isolated synthetic setup probes, explicit connection states, shared OAuth environment policy and setup security contracts.
Packaged the corrective 1.10 release, removed the rigid layout minimum, stabilized a terminal-exit fixture and clarified setup-probe boundaries.
Fixed narrow provider-card layouts after asynchronous hydration and extended UI tests to hydrated headers and maintenance actions.
Reconciled the published 1.10.x and installed 1.11/1.12 development lines; corrected supervisor timeouts and ledger speech, and refreshed walkthroughs and evidence.
Corrected public claims; added evidence tables, prose corroboration, quick/deep tiers, invalid-output diagnostics, broader redaction and explicit installer targets.
Made FAQ answers visible, stripped ANSI/OSC before JSON parsing, published the route table as Markdown and refined the footer.

Explicit signed updates and recovery, per-harness receipts, protocol acceptance, stricter completion evidence, CLI maintenance and attributed version history. Check the linked release record and signature; these notes alone do not establish publication.
